name: Rinhelp
description: Official hosted server for Rinhelp, a help desk for small teams and AI agents. Acts as the teammate who connected it, with their role: list, read, reply to, note, assign, triage, close and reopen conversations; search knowledge; write and publish help center articles; manage saved replies; find Shopify orders and Stripe customers. Refunds, cancellations and other actions that move money or can't be undone wait for a teammate's approval. Sign in with your Rinhelp account via OAuth.
author: Rinhelp
